# SpikingSequenceGenerator

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuromorphic circuit or algorithm that generates ordered spike trains to represent temporal or spatial sequences, such as trajectory waypoints. Provides a building block for temporal pattern generation in event-driven computing, essential for real-time sensory-motor loops in iNEST.
